channel.title: MindExtract
channel.description: MindExtract — download and transcribe video from anywhere

item.title: Version 2.1.2
item.description:
What's New in 2.1.2

  • Much faster link loading — pasting a video link now loads in a few seconds instead of fifteen. The bundled downloader no longer triggers a security re-scan on every use.
  • Instant preview — the video card (title, thumbnail, channel) appears the moment you paste a YouTube or Vimeo link, and Transcribe is available immediately while download qualities finish loading.
  • Updated download engine — yt-dlp updated to the latest release for best site compatibility.
